about: Findings of the grader fuzz harness (scripts/lib/graderFuzz) that are understood and not fixed yet. A signature listed here does not fail a run; any other 'fail' finding does. Each entry says what it is, why it is left, and where it is tracked. Each entry carries a `repro` case; tests/platform/graderFuzzParity.test.mjs replays it and fails once it no longer reproduces, so an entry is deleted with the change that fixes it. An entry marked `replay: timed` depends on the machine's speed and is replayed only by hand (node scripts/fuzz-graders.mjs --replay). See docs/architecture/GRADER_FUZZ.md.
